title: Senior AI Engineer
description: About ROLLERROLLER is not your average software-as-a-service company. With a global presence in over 30 countries, we're here to bring some excitement to the leisure and attractions industry and make a difference! Our mission is to help businesses operate smoothly and create fun and memorable guest experiences by providing seamless ticketing, point-of-sale, self-serve kiosks, memberships and digital waiver processes.But here's the best part: our team. We're a group of 200+ highly passionate, enthusiastic, and down-to-earth professionals located all around the world who are all working together to build something truly remarkable. We're aiming high and believe that the possibilities are endless. As we continue to grow globally, we're excited to write our success story and have fun along the way.We genuinely love what we do, and we're looking for like-minded people to join us on this amazing journey. If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team and make a real impact, come aboard, and let's create some unforgettable experiences together at ROLLER!About The RoleAs a Senior AI Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing and delivering intelligent, scalable systems that harness the power of large language models. You'll contribute to the development of backend infrastructure and AI-powered features that enhance how venues manage operations and deliver exceptional guest experiences. From optimizing support workflows to enabling smarter data insights and automation, your work will help bring innovative, AI-driven capabilities into the ROLLER platform. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you'll help shape the future of guest engagement and operational efficiency for leisure and attractions businesses around the world.What You'll DoDesign and develop scalable AI-driven applications and backend systems using Python and modern software engineering practices.Build and deploy AI agents and workflows with frameworks like LangGraph and LangChain, integrating with LLM APIs and toolchains.Implement and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including embedding strategies and vector database integration.Deploy and manage AI services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using tools like Cloud Functions, Vertex AI, and BigQuery.Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver reliable, high-performing AI features with strong observability, testing, and CI/CD.About YouStrong proficiency in Python, with a solid understanding of software engineering principles.Hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-powered workflows (LangChain/LangGraph or similar).Familiarity with GCP, including deployment, serverless functions, and infrastructure-as-code.Experience with RAG architectures, including chunking strategies, embeddings, and semantic search.Deep understanding of vector databases and their use in LLM applications.Working knowledge of LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini).Understanding of prompt engineering and evaluation methods for LLMs.Experience with modern version control, testing, and DevOps workflows.Nice to HaveExperience with frontend integration of AI systems.Familiarity with other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).Knowledge of agentic frameworks beyond LangChain (e.g., Autogen, CrewAI, AgentOps).Background in data pipelines, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), or real-time data processing.Open source contributions or AI-focused technical writing.Perks!You'll get to work on a category-leading product that customers love in a fun, high-growth industry! Check our Capterra and G2 reviews.Engage in our 'Vibe Tribe' - led by our team members; you can contribute to company-wide initiatives directly. Regular events and social activities, fundraising & cause-related campaigns...you name it. We're willing to make it happen!Team Member Assistance Program to proactively support our team's health and wellbeing - access to coaching, education modules, weekly webinars, and more.16 weeks paid Parental Leave for primary carers and 4 weeks paid Parental Leave for secondary carers.Work with a driven, fun, and switched-on team that likes to raise the bar in all we do!Go on, let's build great product together. If you have any questions, reach out to Reuben at reuben.jamieson@rollerdigital.com Show more Show less

title: AI Engineer
description: About usWe're an independent European digital product studio with a strong track record of delivering market-defining strategies and products for enterprises and governments. With about 200 talented people across three countries, premium AI capabilities and a diverse portfolio of international clients, we define, design and ship high-quality digital products, strategies and software. From global cloud-based platforms and large-scale apps to medical devices, banking software and augmented reality experiences. In a nutshell: if it lives and breathes digital, it’s what we do best.Become a part of our teamAt In The Pocket, you join a multidisciplinary team of designers, engineers, strategists and data specialists who care about the work as much as the people they work with. We work in small, autonomous teams that stay close to our clients and their users, and we give everyone the space to take ownership, speak up and grow. You’ll learn from colleagues across our studios, ship products that reach thousands or even millions of people and help shape what digital can do for leading organisations in Europe.What you’ll do We are looking for an AI Engineer to join In The Pocket. Foundation models have made a lot of things possible that weren't possible a few years ago. Your mission as an AI Engineer is to harness that power and turn it into a capable, reliable and trustworthy product that makes people happy and businesses grow.Design and build AI-powered features on top of foundation models: agents, multimodal retrieval systems, assistants, document analysis, advanced search capabilities.Guide concepts all the way from early idea, to prototype, to production deployment.Build evaluation into the work from the start, proving a system works instead of hoping it does.Facilitate important design decisions such as when a human needs to stay in the loop or when a step can run unsupervised. Design for security and data protection from day one, especially in regulated environments.Work directly with clients: understand what they actually need, ask the awkward questions early, turn a vague ambition into something concrete. Share what you learn with the rest of the AI practice, whether that's a demo, an internal session or a written-up experiment, and pick up what your colleagues have learnt.Who you are You’re a passionate engineer that wants to create elegant solutions for complex problems. You either have a Master's in Computer Science, AI or a related field, or you have a proven track record as an AI engineer.You have a deep knowledge of and hands-on experience with designing, creating and operating LLM-based solutions. You understand the capabilities, limitations and risks of using large language models, and you know how to build a reliable product on top of them (prompt engineering, context engineering, harness engineering,…).You have a deep understanding of concepts such as agents and tools, and you have experience with important industry standards such as MCP, agentskills, A2A.You have experience with retrieval and reranking, embeddings, chunking strategies and vector databases.You’re well aware of common software engineering best practices (CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code,…), and you apply them naturally. You know what secure software looks like and you apply the same standard to AI-generated code as to your own. Familiar with OWASP, and aware of the risks that are specific to LLM systems (prompt injection, data leaking through retrieval, permissions that are too broad).Pragmatic. You are comfortable choosing a simple solution that ships over an elegant one that doesn't, and you can explain the trade-off you made.You work with AI-native tooling and have opinions about it: coding agents, sandboxed execution, MCP, skills and subagents. You enjoy explaining what you know, to colleagues and to clients, rather than keeping it to yourself.You can explain a technical trade-off to someone who isn't technical.You’re fluent in English, and proficient in Dutch or French.What we offer Joining In The Pocket means becoming part of a team that shapes the future of our clients’ businesses across Europe. Here’s what you can look forward to:You’ll start with a permanent contract in a role that comes with responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one.We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and the value you bring.Our benefits package has you covered with hospitalisation and group insurance, meal vouchers, a phone subscription, and more.You’ll have a mobility budget that lets you decide how to get around, your way. Life at In The Pocket isn’t just about work, we host team events throughout the year to celebrate, connect, and have fun together.Learning never stops here, so after six months, you’ll receive a dedicated learning and development budget to keep growing your skills and exploring new horizons.At In The Pocket, we use artificial intelligence to support not replace human judgment. AI can assist our Talent Acquisition processes by helping to pre-screen applications, analyze and summarize CV's and and identify skills gaps.Human oversight is always applied when inviting candidates to interviews. Our Talent Acquisition team reviews AI-supported insights and make the final decision to ensure relevance, fairness, and thoughtful consideration of each candidate’s unique profile.Human managers always make the final hiring decisions to ensure fairness, context, and accountability.AI is a tool to support people not a substitute for human responsibility. title: Generative AI Engineer (Remote, Santiago)
description: Blacksmith Agency Engineering Full time, your only job Remote (Latin America and South Africa)About The RoleBlacksmith Agency is building AI into every part of how we work. As Generative AI Engineer at Blacksmith, you own and ship our internal automation roadmap: production LLM and agent systems that real people on our team use every day. This is a builder role, not research. You will not train models.We hire engineers who have already shipped an LLM system to production and can walk us through it in detail: what it did, how it was built, what broke and what they changed. This is a full-time seat and it has to be your only job.What You Will BuildAgents and workflows with tool use and function calling on Anthropic and OpenAI, with a framework or plain APIs.Evals that prove a change made things better, and guardrails that stop a model taking a wrong or unsafe action.Integrations connecting WordPress, Figma, Google Workspace, Slack and our internal systems, including MCP servers.Internal tools that take measurable hours off delivery, sales operations and project management.What You Bring2+ years building production software in Python or TypeScript / Node.js.At least one LLM or agent system you built yourself that ran in production with real users.Hands-on tool use, evals and failure handling: validating model output, retries, human approval.REST APIs, webhooks and cloud deployment.Strong spoken English. You will talk through technical decisions on live calls with a US team.Not a fit ifYou freelance or contract for other clients and would keep them alongside this job.Your LLM work is demos, tutorials or chat prompting, or your focus is model training and research.How To ApplyApply in two minutes at the link, then take a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment with the same email. Qualified applicants then do a recorded interview in English about systems they have shipped. Show more Show less
